text:
Maya: quick idea thread: build a tiny console tile that shows "est. $/call" for a route. Needs to include token unit price, cache savings, and fallback deltas so teams can spot regressions.
Ravi: telemetry warning: full per-call attribution is too high-cardinality. we should do minutely rollups + sampling.
Becca: propose stratified sampling: always sample up to 5 calls/minute per route, then 0.5% random beyond that. keeps small routes visible.
Tony: implementation note: rollups should include prefix_tokens, gen_tokens, cache_hits_bucket (none/low/med/high), and fallback_count. coarse buckets keep cardinality low.
Maya: UX: show a single number + sparkline. click to expand model breakdown and a tooltip that says "estimate based on sampled telemetry".
Ravi: extrapolation SQL (rough):
```
WITH s AS (
  SELECT route, model, SUM(sample_tokens) as sample_tokens, SUM(sample_count) as sample_count
  FROM sampled_rollups
  GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT s.route, s.model, s.sample_tokens * (totals.total_calls / s.sample_count) as est_tokens
FROM s JOIN totals USING(route,model);
```
Tony: remember price history per model_sku; apply time-weighted price when multiplying tokens.
Becca: also flag when fallback_rate > 10% in the UI so teams don't misinterpret lowered cost as a win. small orange triangle indicator.
infra-bot: canary job scheduled for stratified-sampler Tue 03:00 UTC. link: https://ci.internal/rollouts/est-cost-sample
Maya: action items: 1) infra: sampler (Becca), 2) platform: nightly extrapolation job + price-lookup (Ravi), 3) runtime: emit fallback flag (Tony), 4) product: mock + copy (Maya). I'll file PLAT-9400 and assign.
Tony: I can demo a backend stub next Wed.
Maya: thanks all. :thumbsup:
